Sales/Service Contact Center Quality Assurance and Coaching

Per-call fact table storing AI-derived quality, sentiment, talk-time, compliance checks, and summarization analytics for agent-customer calls; links to Agent (User), Person Account/Lead, Brand, and Scorecard type for QA, coaching, and operational reporting.
